answer: Each epoch, the network auctions 50 haven berths in an ocean of strangers. Newcomers bid credits; the top 50 win and their bids are burned. The entry surface is karst, porous and full of caves where cheap fakes hide, so every opening is priced. At 40 credits a berth, 100 fakes cost 4,000; one honest agent pays 40 once and earns 120 per epoch. Berths are bonded to the bidding key, so a sybil bidding against itself only raises its own price.
